count_pairs_sum_x: count pairs from two arrays whose sum equals a given target value x
run_f_gold: run f_gold to count cross-array pairs that sum to a specified value
test_f_gold: test f_gold against f_filled using the provided parameter sets
summarize_f_gold: summarize the f_gold function that uses a set for O(1) pair sum lookups
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use a two-pointer approach instead of a set
